description: A script for generating configuration files for a build system, managing profiles, feeds, and packages, and executing build commands.

methods.name: run_cmd
methods.description: Executes a command list, optionally printing it if verbose mode is enabled.

methods.name: die
methods.description: Prints messages and exits the program.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Prints usage information for the script.

methods.name: load_yaml
methods.description: Loads and merges YAML profile configurations from specified files.

methods.name: load_yaml_list
methods.description: Loads multiple YAML profile files into a single profile dictionary.

methods.name: extract_sha1_from_revision
methods.description: Validates and extracts SHA-1 hash from revision strings.

methods.name: handle_feed_revision
methods.description: Processes feed information, validating revisions and preparing feed URLs.
